relations: Reaper 让伪装 pixie 的 Ophelia 整日修补毯子并亲自监工；她自估只剩几天。
Jazz 因 mate 纽带离不开 River；四人须同时走，否则 Dante 会被 Reaper 杀。
River 以 Shiv 假名尝试复制她的电梯编织。
Dante 挨饿十余年；Grayson 代管生意并等他重夺王位。

facts.fact: Reaper 楼梯顶咧嘴迎接，喊她 Pixie 开工。
facts.anchor: Reaper was waiting at the top of the stairs. He grinned when he saw me

facts.fact: 牢房堆着至少一百条毯子让她修补。
facts.anchor: He led me into a cell that was stocked with at least a hundred folded blankets

facts.fact: 她加厚软化毯子纤维——黑暗魔法的代价是更不保暖更易坏。
facts.anchor: I thickened the blanket's fibers, and softened them too. The blanket wouldn't hold heat quite as well

facts.fact: 每修一件抛给 Reaper 验收。
facts.anchor: Reaper held out a hand when I was done mending, and I tossed the blanket to him.

facts.fact: 晚饭时她近虚脱，Reaper 拍肩夸干得好。
facts.anchor: Reaper smacked me lightly on the shoulder and told me I'd done well

facts.fact: Dante 抱她直接回牢房；River 来快速核对编织方向。
facts.anchor: Dante held me to his chest as he led me to our cell immediately, instead of to the food line or our normal table.

facts.fact: 当晚 Dante 饿到僵尸态，她递臂任咬。
facts.anchor: I offered Dante my arm, and he bit me without hesitation.

facts.fact: 最后一夜 Dante 谈打算：回去一战重夺王座，自称曾是全城最强吸血鬼。
facts.anchor: Grayson will expect me to retake my throne as soon as I'm back.
